title: Bhooloham
desc: Boologam and Arumugam are two famous boxers whose families are arch-rivals. Taking this into consideration, Deepak, a businessman, hatches a plan to use their rivalry to his advantage.

title: Kuppathu Raja
desc: Rocket, a slum dweller, sees his life change when he joins forces with a gang leader MG Rajendran to put a stop to crime in their area.

title: Dishyum
desc: Bhaskar, a stuntman, is smitten with Cinthya, a college student. However, his heart is broken when he learns that she doesn't love him back but he still tries to persuade her.

title: Thottu Paar
desc: Maharaja collaborates with a police officer to bail out minor offenders. Their actions take an unexpected turn when they assist a gangster who later assassinates a minister.

title: Thodari
desc: Love blossoms between a pantry boy and a makeup artist aboard a train bound for Chennai. However, their journey becomes dangerous when the train is hijacked.
